page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. No margin notes. Verse stanza at the foot of the text, then the closing word FINIS.

p.i: uans,ut nihil dicam grauius,indignißime priuauit, atq; adulterinam quandam sub fcepticipite[?] bestia dynastiam cum fœdißimis eius sordibus, illius loco,ad plebis suae perniciem excepit. O infœlicißima natio,quae à salutari Christi gremio, in Satanae infernalis barathrum,indurata tua pertinacia,merito cecidisti. Propter peccata populi (inquit pijs-simus Iobus) regnare Deus hypocritam fecit. Impius ille spiritus, qui syncera diuini uerbi praedicatione à te exiuerat, cum septem alijs spiritibus se deterioribus, ad te nunc demum redijt, & apud te manet: fitq; tua posterior haec conditio, priore multo deterior. Misericordißimus pater Deus adre-sipiscentiam adhuc te semel prouocet, atq; hoc in Romanam tyrannidem uaticinium tandem adimpleat:
Roma diu titubans, longis erroribus acta Corruet, & mundi desinet esse caput.

page.notes: The first word "uans" is a fragment from the previous page. Italic type covers the whole text; the underlined sentence "Propter peccata populi ... hypocritam fecit." is also italic. "fcepticipite" is doubtful in the scan; the word reads roughly as "sepcticipite" or "fepticipite". "pijs-simus" keeps the printed hyphen at the line end. The closing FINIS is set in spaced capitals with a small printer's ornament after it, which is not transcribed.
